title: Remote Printing Abuse for Lateral Movement
description: Detects remote RPC calls to possibly abuse remote printing service via MS-RPRN / MS-PAR
author: Sagie Dulce, Dekel Paz

logsource.definition: Requirements: install and apply the RPC Firewall to all processes with "audit:true action:block uuid:12345678-1234-abcd-ef00-0123456789ab or 76f03f96-cdfd-44fc-a22c-64950a001209 or ae33069b-a2a8-46ee-a235-ddfd339be281 or 0b6edbfa-4a24-4fc6-8a23-942b1eca65d1
